annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Japan
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies chemicals (e.g., precursors, fentanyl analogues) falling under Export Trade Control Order Appendix 2-3 item 1-2(a).
Lists chemical processing equipment, containment and biological equipment subject to export controls.
Lists electronics, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and CNC machine tools by technical thresholds.
Amended through 2026 with latest enforcement 16 Oct 2026.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese METI ministerial ordinance (2022, as amended to Oct 2026) specifying goods under Export Trade Control Order Appendix 2-3 (catch-all export controls): chemicals, chemical and bio equipment, electronics, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools. No AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: 輸出貿易管理令別表第二の三の規定に基づき貨物を定める省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance Specifying Goods Pursuant to Appendix 2-3 of the Export Trade Control Order
